title: The Mission/Quotes
summary:
"I didn't think you'd actually do it. I trusted you, I looked up to you, I even gave you the Legendary Titan of Spirit. [...] No matter what the Professor does with those Titans, he's planning to make everyone in the world his slave, and you just helped him. [...] Your mentor's life for the future of everyone on Earth?"
- Lok Lambert lashing out at Dante Vale

"His feelings are fighting with his sense of right and wrong. He's tearing up inside."
- Cherit to Lok Lambert on Dante Vale

"I expected Eathon Lambert's son to have a few more tricks up his sleeve."
- The Professor to Sophie Casterwill about Lok Lambert

"What about me?" (Sophie Casterwill)

"[chuckles] What about you? [...] You're merely a holdover from a washed-up fan of Seekers. Do you really think you can stop me?" (The Professor)

"Infuriating. Every time I move to destroy you, you come with some trick to keep yourself alive."
- The Professor to Sophie Casterwill

"It's not over; it's just getting started. Sabriel was more than a Titan, she was my friend, and she's been with me my entire life."
- Sophie Casterwill to The Professor about Sabriel

"I guess this is it. Dante, I wanted to tell you, when we met I acted tough but really I was weak until you..." (Zhalia Moon thinking it's all over)

"Until I what? [...] I'm sorry I kept you waiting." (Dante Vale suddenly gaining consciousness)

"I'll chew you out later." (Zhalia Moon)

"Good thing I always carry a spare!"

- Dante Vale reveals to Zhalia Moon that he always owned two Caliban Titans

"I have ten times your power!"
- The Professor to Sophie Casterwill

"Eathon Lambert was always by Simon's side. I had a hunch the Professor wanted someone just as loyal."
-Dante Vale to Zhalia Moon about Eathon the dog's name

"Lok, I can't undo what I've done, but I'm gonna try and make up for it, starting right now."
-Dante Vale to Lok Lambert

"Dante, I've got a plan." (Lok Lambert)

"It's your show, Lok. We're just here to back you up." (Dante Vale)

"Zhalia, you were supposed to return Gar-Ghoul safely to Huntik Foundation headquarters." (Dante Vale)

"Sorry, but you should've known." (Zhalia Moon)

"No! I must retain control of Overlos. I must have control, of everything!"

- Simon Judeau upon Lok Lambert gaining control of Overlos

"History may very well remember you as the greatest Seekers of your time."
- LeBlanche to the team

"My father, I know he's still out there, maybe there's a clue in what the Professor said, and maybe one day I'll bring dad home."
- Lok Lambert thinking to himself

"Maybe Lok should be team leader from now on." (Sophie Casterwill)

"Sure, I'm a master Seeker now. No matter what happens, I've got it covered." (Lok Lambert)

"Oh really? Because you know, school starts on Monday." (Sophie Casterwill)

"What? Summer's vacation over? Already? Oh!" (Lok Lambert)
